side.why: Your railway can build a Cannery now: it turns fish into canned fish.
side.title: Build a 🥫 Cannery
side.how: 🏗 Build → Cannery: beside your track, near where its fish comes from
side.mira: “Your railway can build a Cannery now: it turns fish into canned fish. A Cannery would change everything,” Mira says.

side.title: Reach Fernhallow
side.how: Build a ⚓ Dock on its shore within sea reach of your dock: ships carry goods across.
side.mira: Mira unrolls a sea chart. “Fernhallow. They say it’s a timber island, with iron in its hills. Let’s go and see.”

done.title: Find the town west of Ashford

ms.actLine: The platforms had to be lengthened. Mira didn’t complain.

main.title: Help Tidewick become a Megacity
main.how: It still needs 🍞 flour. Tap it to see where each comes from, then tap ⬆ Grow.
main.mira: “If Tidewick gets flour, it becomes a megacity,” Mira says. “That’s more trade for us.”
